explanation: B offers the strongest short-budget fit: layer normalization amplifies initially small hidden features, while the residual path preserves input-dependent information and supports learning the substantial linear trend. Its leaky-ReLU units also provide flexible nonlinear features. A adds another normalized, nonresidual stage, making optimization more indirect at the small Adagrad learning rate. C preserves the residual path but lacks normalization, so its extra width is unlikely to compensate for slower feature learning within 256 steps.
